digest_kind_explanation: These sha256 strings are the layer digests ollama's manifest declares, and they are also the blob filenames under OLLAMA_MODELS=/data4/OllamaModels/models/blobs. They were read from the manifest, not produced by hashing the 6.2 GB files, because a full recompute would have added minutes of disk I/O while the re-run holds the machine. Anyone who needs a recomputed digest should run sha256sum on the blob path after the run finishes and compare byte-for-byte.
